Kress, age 59, to serve as interim Chief Executive Officer, while the Board conducts a search for a new Chief Executive Officer. On November 11, 2026, the Board appointed Harvey C. Jones, age 73, as Chair of the Board. Mr. Jones has served on the Board since 1993. He has been the Managing Partner of Square Wave Ventures, a private family office, since 2004 and has over 30 years of experience as an entrepreneur, high technology executive, and venture investor.
